label: Profits of a permanent establishment in Spain

note: Spain levies no separate tax on distributed profits; dividends paid to non-residents are subject to non-resident income tax withholding (not covered here).

section: Branch profits tax (gravamen complementario on permanent establishments)
label: Exemption: EU-resident companies
value: Not charged on a permanent establishment of a company resident in another EU Member State, unless it is a tax haven
note: Spain levies no separate tax on distributed profits; dividends paid to non-residents are subject to non-resident income tax withholding (not covered here).

section: Branch profits tax (gravamen complementario on permanent establishments)
label: Exemption: treaty countries
value: Not charged on a permanent establishment of a company resident in a country with a double tax treaty with Spain that does not provide otherwise, if there is reciprocal treatment
note: Spain levies no separate tax on distributed profits; dividends paid to non-residents are subject to non-resident income tax withholding (not covered here).
source_title: Real Decreto Legislativo 5/2004, texto refundido de la Ley del Impuesto sobre la Renta de no Residentes, artículo 19 (BOE, texto consolidado, última actualización publicada el 25/05/2023)

section: Non-residents: employment income (IRNR)
label: Residence test (LIRPF art. 9)
value: Resident if in Spain for more than 183 days in the calendar year (sporadic absences count unless residence elsewhere is proven), or if the main centre or base of activities or economic interests is in Spain; presumed resident if the spouse and dependent minor children live in Spain
note: Double tax treaties can reduce or remove Spanish tax on a non-resident's employment income.
source_title: Ley 35/2006, del Impuesto sobre la Renta de las Personas Físicas, artículo 9 (BOE, texto consolidado, última actualización publicada el 11/11/2026)

section: Contractors: employee or self-employed, and withholding on fees
label: Official test: employee or self-employed
value: An employee works voluntarily, for pay, for another person and within that person's organisation and direction (Estatuto de los Trabajadores art. 1.1); an employment contract is presumed between whoever provides a service in that way and whoever receives it for pay (art. 8.1)
note: Withholding applies when the payer is a business or professional; it is a payment on account of the payee's IRPF.
